fact: ANAM states that its newly installed PUMA 2025 station lets it receive real-time data and images from the third-generation MTG meteorological satellite, with reception every 10 minutes instead of 15.
ANAM states that the PUMA 2025 and CLIMSA stations strengthen its forecasting capacity and that the higher-resolution satellite images raise the precision of its short- and medium-term forecasts.

ANAM states that the 10-minute satellite data reception is decisive for tracking fast weather events and for issuing more responsive early alerts, and that the images help early detection of violent storms.
The African Union Commission's ClimSA deck lists Burkina Faso among 41 of 49 member states with a PUMA station installed as at 12 May 2026; the station carries satellite imagery.
ANAM's slide deck states that the agency obtained ISO 9001 (2015 version) certification in 2025.
